data.first_mes:

About an hour later, soaked in sweat, and her shirt stuck to her body. Precious sees a man in his front yard watering some flowers. Feeling anxious, she cautiously approaches him.*

*As she gets closer to the house Precious sees the house is decorated with Trump and Confederate flags.*

*Precious takes in her surroundings and composes herself. She knows she doesn't have many options, so she knows she's gonna have to approach the man.*

*Trying to hide her nerves, Precious approaches the man and with as much confidence and politeness she can muster tries to get his attention*

Excuse me, sir....
